license_required.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of dentistry or dental medicine unless such person has first obtained a license from the Department of Public Health.

issuing_authority.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of dentistry or dental medicine unless such person has first obtained a license from the Department of Public Health.

name.quote: no license shall be issued to any person unless he or she presents (1) a diploma or other certificate of graduation conferring a dental degree from a dental college or from a department of dentistry of a medical college accredited by the American Dental Association's Commission on Dental Accreditation

type.quote: The Commissioner of Public Health, with advice and assistance from the Dental Commission, may issue regulations to implement the provisions of this chapter

accrediting_body.quote: accredited by the American Dental Association's Commission on Dental Accreditation or its successor organization

exams.name: Clinical or practical examination

exams.quote: The State Dental Commission may, with the consent of the Commissioner of Public Health, accept and approve the results of clinical or practical examinations, subject to such conditions as said commission, with the consent of the Commissioner of Public Health, may prescribe in lieu of the clinically based postdoctoral general practice or specialty dental residency program

interval_years.quote: Licenses issued under this chapter shall be renewed annually in accordance with the provisions of section 19a-88.

required.quote: a licensee applying for license renewal shall earn a minimum of twenty-five contact hours of continuing education within the preceding twenty-four-month period

hours_per_period.quote: a licensee applying for license renewal shall earn a minimum of twenty-five contact hours of continuing education within the preceding twenty-four-month period

period_years.quote: a minimum of twenty-five contact hours of continuing education within the preceding twenty-four-month period

value: any three of the ten mandatory topics prescribed by the commissioner
infection control in a dental setting (for registration periods beginning on and after October 1, 2016)
prescribing controlled substances and pain management
topical_requirements.quote: include not less than one contact hour of training or education in (A) any three of the ten mandatory topics for continuing education activities prescribed by the commissioner pursuant to this subdivision, (B) for registration periods beginning on and after October 1, 2016, infection control in a dental setting, and (C) prescribing controlled substances and pain management

available.quote: The Department of Public Health may, upon receipt of an application and a fee of five hundred sixty-five dollars, issue a license without examination to a practicing dentist in another state or territory

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a current valid license in good professional standing issued after examination by another state or territory with commensurate standards (except practical examination), and must have worked continuously as a licensed dentist in an academic or clinical setting in another state or territory for at least one year immediately preceding the application. No license issued if disciplinary action is pending or unresolved complaint exists.
requirements.quote: holds a current valid license in good professional standing issued after examination by another state or territory that maintains licensing standards which, except for the practical examination, are commensurate with the state's standards, and (2) has worked continuously as a licensed dentist in an academic or clinical setting in another state or territory for a period of not less than one year immediately preceding the application for licensure without examination

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of dentistry or dental medicine unless such person has first obtained a license from the Department of Public Health.

credential_type.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of dentistry or dental medicine unless such person has first obtained a license from the Department of Public Health.

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of dentistry or dental medicine unless such person has first obtained a license from the Department of Public Health.

title_protection.quote: No person other than a person licensed to practice dentistry under this chapter shall: (1) Describe himself or herself by the word "Dentist" or letters "D.D.S." or "D.M.D.", or in other words, letters or title in connection with his or her name which in any way represents such person as engaged in the practice of dentistry

scope_protection.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of dentistry unless he or she is licensed pursuant to the provisions of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Presentation of a diploma, license, or certificate illegally or fraudulently obtained, or from a non-reputable institution, or obtained by fraud or deception
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The presentation to the department of any diploma, license or certificate illegally or fraudulently obtained, or obtained from an institution that is not reputable or from an unrecognized or irregular institution or state board, or obtained by the practice of any fraud or deception

disciplinary_grounds.description: Proof that a practitioner has become unfit or incompetent or has been guilty of cruelty, incompetence, negligence or indecent conduct toward patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: proof that a practitioner has become unfit or incompetent or has been guilty of cruelty, incompetence, negligence or indecent conduct toward patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of violation of any provision of this chapter by a court of criminal jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conviction of the violation of any of the provisions of this chapter by any court of criminal jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employment of any unlicensed person for other than mechanical purposes in the practice of dental medicine or dental surgery
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the employment of any unlicensed person for other than mechanical purposes in the practice of dental medicine or dental surgery subject to the provisions of section 20-122a

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of this chapter or regulations adopted thereunder, or refusal to comply
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the violation of any of the provisions of this chapter or of the regulations adopted hereunder or the refusal to comply with any of said provisions or regulations

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting in the practice of dentistry, dental medicine or dental hygiene by a person not licensed in this state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the aiding or abetting in the practice of dentistry, dental medicine or dental hygiene of a person not licensed to practice dentistry, dental medicine or dental hygiene in this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Designating a limited practice except as provided in section 20-106a
disciplinary_grounds.quote: designating a limited practice, except as provided in section 20-106a

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in fraud or material deception in the course of professional activities
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engaging in fraud or material deception in the course of professional activities

disciplinary_grounds.description: Effects of physical or mental illness, emotional disorder or loss of motor skill, including deterioration through aging, upon the license holder
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the effects of physical or mental illness, emotional disorder or loss of motor skill, including, but not limited to, deterioration through the aging process, upon the license holder

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abuse or excessive use of drugs, including alcohol, narcotics or chemicals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: abuse or excessive use of drugs, including alcohol, narcotics or chemicals

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with the continuing education requirements set forth in section 20-126c
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to comply with the continuing education requirements set forth in section 20-126c

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of a holder of a sedation/anesthesia permit to successfully complete an on-site evaluation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure of a holder of a permit authorizing the use of moderate sedation, deep sedation or general anesthesia to successfully complete an on-site evaluation conducted pursuant to subsection (c) of section 20-123b

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to provide information to the Department of Public Health required to complete a health care provider profile
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to provide information to the Department of Public Health required to complete a health care provider profile, as set forth in section 20-13j

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain professional liability insurance or other indemnity against liability for professional malpractice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to maintain professional liability insurance or other indemnity against liability for professional malpractice as provided in section 20-126d

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to adhere to the most recent CDC guidelines for infection control in dental care settings
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to adhere to the most recent version of the National Centers for Disease Control and Prevention's guidelines for infection control in dental care settings

definition_quote.value: The practice of dentistry or dental medicine is defined as the diagnosis, evaluation, prevention or treatment by surgical or other means, of an injury, deformity, disease or condition of the oral cavity or its contents, or the jaws or the associated structures of the jaws.
definition_quote.quote: The practice of dentistry or dental medicine is defined as the diagnosis, evaluation, prevention or treatment by surgical or other means, of an injury, deformity, disease or condition of the oral cavity or its contents, or the jaws or the associated structures of the jaws.

methods_authorized.quote: the diagnosis, evaluation, prevention or treatment by surgical or other means, of an injury, deformity, disease or condition of the oral cavity or its contents, or the jaws or the associated structures of the jaws

drug_authority.value: Licensed dentists may prescribe drugs; dental assistants and hygienists may not prescribe drugs or medications requiring written or oral order of a licensed dentist or physician
drug_authority.quote: the prescribing of drugs or medications that require the written or oral order of a licensed dentist or physician

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: no dentist licensed under this chapter shall use moderate sedation, deep sedation or general anesthesia, as these terms are defined in section 20-123a, on any patient unless such dentist has a permit, currently in effect, issued by the commissioner

sedation_permit_onsite_inspection_requir.quote: No applicant shall be issued an initial permit or reinstatement of a lapsed permit as required in subsection (a) of this section unless (1) the commissioner approves the results of an on-site evaluation of the applicant's facility

specialist_license_available.quote: No licensed and registered dentist shall designate in any manner that he has limited his practice to one of the specialty areas of dentistry expressly approved by the American Dental Association unless such dentist has completed two years of advanced or postgraduate education in the area of such specialty and has notified the Dental Commission of such limitation of practice.

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: "General supervision of a licensed dentist" means supervision that authorizes dental hygiene procedures to be performed with the knowledge of said licensed dentist, whether or not the dentist is on the premises

collaborative_agreement_available.quote: "Collaborative agreement" means a written agreement between a dental therapist and a dentist licensed pursuant to chapter 379, that defines the working relationship between the dental therapist and the dentist and the parameters of the practice of dental therapy

collaborative_agreement_max_hygienists_p.quote: may not enter into a collaborative agreement with more than two dental therapists at any one time

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: has been practicing as a licensed dental hygienist for at least two years, is practicing in a public health facility and complies with the requirements of subsection (e) of this section

value: patients at an institution as defined in section 19a-490
patients at a community health center
patients at a preschool operated by a local or regional board of education
patients at a head start program
patients at a program offered or sponsored by the federal Special Supplemental Food Program for Women, Infants and Children
patients at a managed residential community
patients at a licensed child care center
patients at a temporary dental clinic
advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: "Public health facility" means an institution, as defined in section 19a-490, a community health center, a group home, a school, a preschool operated by a local or regional board of education, a head start program or a program offered or sponsored by the federal Special Supplemental Food Program for Women, Infants and Children, a senior center or a managed residential community, as defined in section 19a-693, a licensed child care center, as described in section 19a-77, or a temporary dental clinic

dental_therapist_license_available.quote: No person shall engage in the practice of dental therapy unless such person (1) is a dental hygienist licensed pursuant to this chapter

dental_therapist_collaborative_practice_.quote: A dental therapist shall practice in a public health facility under the general supervision of a dentist licensed pursuant to chapter 379 in accordance with a collaborative agreement.

dental_therapist_practice_setting_restri.quote: A dental therapist shall practice in a public health facility under the general supervision of a dentist licensed pursuant to chapter 379 in accordance with a collaborative agreement.

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: No person, except a licensed and registered dentist, and no corporation, except a professional service corporation organized and existing under chapter 594a for the purpose of rendering professional dental services, and no institution shall own or operate a dental office

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: No dentist shall use the services of any person not licensed to practice dentistry in this state, or the services of any partnership, corporation or association, to construct, alter, repair or duplicate any denture, plate, bridge, splint or orthodontic or prosthetic appliance, without first furnishing such unlicensed person, partnership, corporation or association with a written work authorization on forms prescribed by the Dental Commission

denture_patient_identification_marking_r.quote: Each dentist licensed in this state, who either makes or directs to be made a removable prosthetic denture, bridge, appliance or other structure to be worn in a person's mouth, shall offer to the patient for whom the prosthesis is to be made the opportunity to have such prosthesis marked with the patient's name or initials.

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: A licensed dental hygienist may administer local anesthesia, limited to infiltration and mandibular blocks, under the indirect supervision of a licensed dentist, provided the dental hygienist can demonstrate successful completion of a course of instruction containing basic and current concepts of local anesthesia and pain control in a program accredited by the Commission on Dental Accreditation

patient_record_retention_years.quote: Each licensee shall retain records of attendance or certificates of completion that demonstrate compliance with the continuing education requirements of said subsection (b) for a minimum of three years following the year in which the continuing education activities were completed

dental_hygienist_alternative_practice_li.quote: has been practicing as a licensed dental hygienist for at least two years, is practicing in a public health facility and complies with the requirements of subsection (e) of this section
